About Organization

The UPSRTC is a state-owned road transport corporation in India.

It is responsible for providing bus services in the state of Uttar Pradesh.

About the Programme

The UPSRTC Bus Conductor Recruitment is a job opportunity for individuals who want to work as bus conductors in Uttar Pradesh.

The programme aims to recruit 64 bus conductors in Prayagraj, Pratapgarh, Kaushambi, and Mirzapur.
